poll_interval.label: Poll interval
poll_interval.description: How often to ask the local OpenCode server for active sessions, permissions, and current activity.

recent_minutes.label: Recent session window
recent_minutes.description: Show sessions updated within this many minutes in the recent list.

recent_count.label: Recent session limit
recent_count.description: Maximum number of recent sessions shown in the panel.

display_mode.label: Bar display
display_mode.description: Activity shows the current tool or waiting reason; counts shows a compact active count; dots shows up to six dots, one per visible session.

show_label.label: Show label
show_label.description: Show text next to the bar icon. Disable for an icon-and-dots only widget.

label_width.label: Label width
label_width.description: Maximum number of characters shown in the bar label.

glyph.label: Icon
glyph.description: Tabler glyph used when OpenCode is idle.

show_children.label: Show child sessions
show_children.description: Include subagent and child sessions in the bar widget. The panel always shows them.
